ui_devex.name: axios
ui_devex.summary: Axios 是一个基于 Promise 的 HTTP 客户端库，统一了浏览器和 Node.js 环境中的网络请求处理，解决了不同平台 API 差异带来的开发复杂度。其核心技术在于自动的 JSON 数据转换和拦截器机制，让开发者能够优雅地插入认证、日志等通用逻辑。实际应用中，你可以快速将其集成到前端项目中进行 API 调用，或利用拦截器实现请求重试、错误统一处理等企业级功能，显著提升网络编程的效率和可维护性。
ui_devex.summary_en: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client that simplifies making API requests across browsers and Node.js environments, eliminating the complexity of native fetch APIs. Its elegant design automatically transforms JSON data and provides built-in request/response interceptors for seamless authentication and error handling. Developers can immediately integrate it into web apps for RESTful API calls, or extend its interceptors to implement custom logging, caching, or retry logic for robust network operations.

ui_devex.name: TypeScript
ui_devex.summary: TypeScript 是 JavaScript 的超集，通过引入静态类型系统帮助开发者在编码阶段发现错误，提升代码质量和可维护性。其核心设计采用渐进式类型，允许在现有 JavaScript 项目中逐步添加类型约束，同时保持完全兼容。开发者可从为变量添加基础类型注解开始，逐步使用接口、泛型等高级特性，结合 IDE 的智能提示和重构工具，构建更可靠的前后端应用，特别适合大型项目协作和长期维护。
ui_devex.summary_en: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that adds static type checking to help developers catch errors early and write more maintainable code. Its key innovation is gradual typing, allowing developers to add types incrementally while maintaining full JavaScript compatibility. You can start by adding type annotations to existing JavaScript files, then leverage advanced features like interfaces and generics to build robust applications with better tooling support and autocompletion.

ui_devex.name: FreeDomain
ui_devex.summary: FreeDomain 是一个开源域名注册平台，旨在为开发者和初创项目提供免费的域名服务，降低技术项目的入门门槛。该项目采用 HTML 构建简洁的网页界面，用户可直接在线申请和管理域名，无需支付费用。开发者可将其部署到本地环境，搭建个性化的域名分发系统，或借鉴其域名分配逻辑集成到自己的应用中，非常适合用于项目演示、测试环境搭建或教育用途的实践探索。

Built primarily with HTML, it offers a straightforward web interface for users to claim and manage domains without financial commitment. You can deploy it locally to create custom domain services or integrate its domain management logic into your own applications for testing and development purposes.

ui_devex.name: nodebestpractices
ui_devex.summary: NodeBestPractices 是一个全面的 Node.js 开发最佳实践集合，帮助开发者通过系统化的指导避免常见陷阱，构建更可靠、可维护的应用程序。它将实践分为项目结构、错误处理、测试等模块，每个建议都配有具体代码示例和原理说明，而非抽象理论。开发者可在代码审查时参考这些规范，将关键检查点集成到持续集成流程中，或逐步改造现有项目——比如从改进错误处理开始，再到优化性能和安全配置，实现渐进式的质量提升。
ui_devex.summary_en: NodeBestPractices is a comprehensive collection of Node.js development guidelines that helps developers build more reliable and maintainable applications by addressing common pitfalls and architectural challenges. It organizes best practices into actionable categories like project structure, error handling, and testing, providing concrete code examples and explanations rather than abstract principles. Developers can use it as a reference during code reviews, integrate specific practices into their CI/CD pipelines, or systematically improve existing codebases by implementing its modular recommendations incrementally.

ui_devex.name: create-react-app
ui_devex.summary: Create React App 是一个零配置的构建工具，专门解决现代 React 开发环境搭建的复杂性。它通过预置的构建流程抽象了繁琐的 Webpack 和 Babel 配置，同时保留通过“eject”完全自定义的灵活性。开发者只需一条命令即可启动具备热重载、代码分割和生产优化的 React 应用，非常适合快速原型开发、学习 React 框架或高效启动新项目，让前端开发聚焦于业务逻辑而非构建配置。
ui_devex.summary_en: Create React App is a zero-configuration build tool that solves the complexity of setting up modern React development environments by providing pre-configured build pipelines. Its key innovation is abstracting away complex Webpack and Babel configurations while maintaining full customization escape hatches through 'ejecting'. Developers can immediately start building production-ready React applications with hot reloading, code splitting, and optimized builds using a single command, making it ideal for prototyping, learning React, or rapid project initialization.

ui_devex.name: godot
ui_devex.summary: Godot Engine 是一款开源跨平台游戏引擎，专为 2D 和 3D 游戏开发设计，让创作者无需支付授权费用即可制作高质量游戏。其核心采用场景与节点系统，通过组合式架构管理游戏对象，支持灵活的层级关系与资源复用。引擎内置 GDScript 脚本语言便于快速原型开发，同时支持 C# 扩展与 C++ 模块定制，适合独立游戏、教育模拟及多平台发布等场景，开发者可轻松上手并实现创意构想。
ui_devex.summary_en: Godot Engine is a free, open-source game development platform that enables creators to build 2D and 3D games without licensing fees. Its scene and node system provides a flexible, intuitive approach to game object composition and hierarchy management. Developers can prototype rapidly using GDScript, extend functionality with C#, or integrate custom modules via its C++ core, making it ideal for indie projects, educational tools, and cross-platform releases.

ui_devex.name: generative-ai-for-beginners
ui_devex.summary: 《生成式AI入门指南》是一个包含21节课程的完整学习路径，通过Jupyter笔记本实践教学，帮助初学者系统掌握生成式AI的核心技术。课程深入讲解提示工程、模型微调等关键概念，并展示如何集成Azure AI服务和OpenAI API进行实际开发。学习者可以按照结构化课程构建真实应用，体验不同AI模型的效果，掌握在实际项目中部署生成式AI解决方案的方法，为深入探索人工智能领域打下坚实基础。
ui_devex.summary_en: Generative AI for Beginners is a comprehensive 21-lesson curriculum that demystifies generative AI for newcomers by providing hands-on learning through Jupyter notebooks. It teaches core concepts like prompt engineering and model fine-tuning while demonstrating practical integration with Azure AI services and OpenAI APIs. Developers can follow the structured lessons to build real applications, experiment with different AI models, and understand how to deploy generative AI solutions effectively in their projects.

ui_devex.name: DeepSeek-V3
ui_devex.summary: DeepSeek-V3 是一款先进的开源语言模型，旨在解决强大AI推理能力与计算资源需求之间的平衡问题。它采用创新的专家混合架构和高效训练技术，在保持高性能的同时实现更实用的部署方案。该模型通过精心设计的参数分配和激活机制，让大规模语言能力能够在常规硬件上运行。开发者可通过Hugging Face平台直接调用，用于文本生成、代码辅助或研究实验，特别适合需要复杂语言理解能力但资源有限的应用场景，为构建智能应用提供了新的可能性。
ui_devex.summary_en: DeepSeek-V3 is an advanced open-source language model that tackles the challenge of making powerful AI reasoning accessible without massive computational requirements. It employs innovative Mixture-of-Experts architecture and efficient training techniques to deliver high-performance capabilities while maintaining practical deployment feasibility. Developers can integrate it via Hugging Face for text generation, code assistance, or research experiments, making it ideal for building intelligent applications that require sophisticated language understanding without enterprise-scale infrastructure.

ui_devex.summary: IPTV-org 是一个汇集全球公开 IPTV 频道的项目，解决了用户难以统一获取世界各地电视直播源的痛点。它通过 TypeScript 实现自动化管理，将数千个频道按国家、语言分类为标准化 M3U 播放列表，确保数据持续更新且易于解析。开发者可直接在 VLC、Kodi 等播放器中加载列表观看国际新闻与体育赛事，或基于其 API 构建定制化应用，例如创建专属频道导航或内容推荐系统，快速实验多源流媒体整合方案。

ui_devex.summary: Puppeteer 是一个 Node.js 库，提供高级 API 来编程控制 Chrome 或 Firefox 浏览器，解决了测试和网页抓取中浏览器自动化的需求。其核心技术是通过 DevTools 协议与浏览器直接通信，实现对页面、网络请求和用户交互的精确控制，无需人工干预。开发者可用它自动化表单提交、生成页面截图、测试 Web 应用或抓取动态内容，只需用 JavaScript 编写浏览器操作脚本即可快速上手实验。
ui_devex.summary_en: Puppeteer is a Node.js library that provides a high-level API to control Chrome or Firefox browsers programmatically, solving the need for reliable browser automation in testing and web scraping. Its key innovation is using the DevTools Protocol to communicate directly with browsers, enabling precise control over pages, network requests, and user interactions without manual intervention. Developers can use it to automate form submissions, generate screenshots, test web applications, or scrape dynamic content by scripting browser actions in JavaScript.

ui_devex.name: DeepSeek-R1
ui_devex.summary: DeepSeek-R1 是一个开源推理模型，专门解决需要多步骤逻辑思考的复杂问题，使人工智能能够更好地应对现实世界中的分析挑战。它采用思维链推理和自我验证机制，将问题系统分解并验证中间结论，从而提升推理的可靠性。开发者可通过其API或针对特定领域数据进行微调，将其集成到教育工具、数据分析流程或自动故障排查系统等应用中，探索智能推理在实际场景中的潜力。
ui_devex.summary_en: DeepSeek-R1 is an open-source reasoning model that tackles complex problem-solving tasks requiring multi-step logical thinking, making AI more capable of handling real-world analytical challenges. It employs chain-of-thought reasoning and self-verification mechanisms to break down problems systematically and validate intermediate conclusions, enhancing reliability. Developers can integrate it into applications needing structured reasoning, such as educational tools, data analysis pipelines, or automated troubleshooting systems, by leveraging its API or fine-tuning on domain-specific datasets.

ui_devex.summary: 该项目系统整理了多种AI编程工具的系统提示词与模型配置，帮助开发者深入理解不同AI助手处理编程任务的内在逻辑。通过分析Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Devin AI等工具的实际工作指令，你可以学习到如何设计有效的AI交互模式。这些资源展示了不同工具如何构建代码补全、错误修复和项目开发的智能辅助流程。你可以直接借鉴这些提示词模板，根据特定编程语言或开发场景进行定制化调整，或者通过对比研究来优化自己的AI工具使用策略，提升开发效率。
ui_devex.summary_en: This repository collects system prompts and models from various AI coding tools, helping developers understand how different AI assistants approach programming tasks. It reveals the underlying instructions that shape AI behavior across platforms like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Devin AI. You can study these prompts to learn effective AI communication patterns, adapt them for your own projects, or compare how different tools structure their coding assistance. Try modifying these system prompts to customize AI behavior for specific programming languages or development workflows.

ui_devex.summary: ComfyUI 是一款基于节点界面的扩散模型工具，通过可视化编程让复杂AI图像生成流程变得直观可控。其模块化设计将高级AI管线拆解为可组合的组件，揭示了如何通过节点连接实现灵活的工作流编排。用户可通过拖拽节点构建自定义生成流程，修改现有图像处理管线，或基于其后端API开发全新的视觉AI应用，非常适合想要深入理解扩散模型工作原理并创建个性化图像生成方案的研究者和开发者。
ui_devex.summary_en: ComfyUI is a powerful node-based interface that makes complex AI image generation workflows accessible through visual programming. Its modular architecture allows users to chain together diffusion model components like building blocks, revealing how advanced AI pipelines can be decomposed into reusable elements. You can experiment by dragging nodes to create custom generation workflows, modify existing pipelines, or build entirely new visual AI applications using its API backend.

ui_devex.name: tailwindcss
ui_devex.summary: Tailwind CSS 是一个实用优先的 CSS 框架，通过提供原子化的 CSS 类来解决传统 CSS 文件臃肿和命名复杂的问题。其技术核心在于直接在 HTML 中使用预设的实用类组合构建界面，无需编写自定义 CSS，从而实现快速响应式开发和一致的设计系统。开发者可通过 PostCSS 集成到任何项目中，通过配置文件定制设计规范，并完全使用实用类构建完整界面，无需编写传统 CSS 文件即可实现现代化网页设计。
ui_devex.summary_en: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework that solves the problem of bloated CSS files and complex naming conventions by providing low-level utility classes for rapid UI development. Its technical innovation lies in composing designs directly in HTML using predefined classes instead of writing custom CSS, enabling consistent design systems and responsive layouts. Developers can integrate it into any project via PostCSS, customize the design system through configuration files, and build complete interfaces without writing traditional CSS files.

ui_devex.name: vue-element-admin
ui_devex.summary: Vue Element Admin 是一个基于 Vue.js 和 Element UI 构建的完整后台管理系统模板，解决了企业级管理界面快速开发的难题。它通过预置用户管理、数据可视化、权限控制等常用模块，并支持国际化，让开发者能直接复用成熟的界面模式。技术亮点包括动态路由配置、角色权限管理和响应式布局设计，展示了如何优雅处理复杂的前端状态和交互逻辑。你可以将其作为项目起点，根据业务需求定制组件，或学习其模块化架构来优化自己的管理后台开发流程。
ui_devex.summary_en: Vue Element Admin is a comprehensive admin dashboard template built with Vue.js and Element UI that solves the challenge of rapidly developing enterprise management interfaces. Its technical strength lies in providing pre-built components for common admin tasks like user management, data visualization, and permission control with internationalization support. Developers can use it as a starter template, customize the layout and components for their specific needs, or study its implementation of complex UI patterns like dynamic routing and role-based access control.

ui_devex.name: supabase
ui_devex.summary: Supabase 是一个开源的 Firebase 替代方案，为开发者提供基于 PostgreSQL 的完整后端解决方案，无需分别管理数据库、身份验证和 API 服务。其核心设计巧妙利用 PostgreSQL 原生功能，通过内置扩展实现行级安全策略和实时数据订阅，同时根据数据库模式自动生成类型安全的 API 接口。开发者可直接连接 Supabase 项目快速构建全栈应用，立即专注于前端开发而无需担心后端基础设施，特别适合需要实时功能、严格数据权限控制的 Web 和移动应用场景，让团队以最小配置获得生产就绪的后端服务。
ui_devex.summary_en: Supabase is an open-source Firebase alternative that provides developers with a complete backend solution using PostgreSQL, eliminating the need to manage separate services for databases, authentication, and APIs. ui_devex.name: storybook
ui_devex.summary: Storybook 是一个开源工具，专门解决在独立环境中开发 UI 组件的难题，让开发者无需依赖完整应用即可构建和测试组件。它通过创建“故事”来展示组件在不同属性和状态下的表现，支持实时编辑和交互测试，便于团队协作和视觉验证。你可以用它搭建组件库、编写设计系统文档，或集成自动化测试工具进行视觉回归测试，提升前端开发效率和质量。
ui_devex.summary_en: Storybook is an open-source tool that solves the challenge of developing UI components in isolation from the main application, preventing context-switching and enabling focused testing. It works by creating 'stories'—reusable test cases that render components with specific props and states, allowing developers to visually verify behavior across different scenarios. You can use it to build component libraries, document design systems, or automate visual regression testing by integrating with testing frameworks like Chromatic or Percy.

ui_devex.name: v2rayN
ui_devex.summary: v2rayN 是一款跨平台图形化代理客户端，核心解决网络访问限制与隐私保护问题，通过集成 Xray、sing-box 等内核支持 V2Ray、Trojan 等多种协议。其设计亮点在于将复杂的代理配置抽象为直观操作界面，让用户无需深入协议细节即可灵活组合路由规则。实际应用中，你可快速部署于 Windows、Linux 或 macOS 系统，用于突破地域内容封锁、加密敏感数据传输，或为特定应用设置独立代理通道——无论是开发跨境服务测试，还是构建个人隐私网络，都能直接上手实践。
ui_devex.summary_en: v2rayN is a versatile GUI client that enables secure internet access by routing traffic through multiple proxy protocols, addressing censorship and privacy concerns. It uniquely integrates Xray, sing-box, and other cores into a unified interface, simplifying complex proxy configurations for everyday users. You can deploy it on Windows, Linux, or macOS to bypass geo-restrictions, encrypt connections, or build custom routing rules for specific applications—ideal for developers testing region-locked services or privacy-conscious users seeking reliable anonymity tools.

ui_devex.name: llama.cpp
ui_devex.summary: Llama.cpp 是一个用 C/C++ 实现的开源项目，专门解决在普通硬件上高效运行大语言模型的难题，让用户无需依赖昂贵的云端计算资源。它通过 GGML 量化技术和优化的 CPU 计算实现高性能推理，展示了如何通过精细的内存管理让数十亿参数模型在本地设备上流畅运行。开发者可以将其集成到桌面应用中，构建本地 AI 助手，或利用其简洁的 C/C++ API 进行自定义模型部署实验，非常适合需要实时文本生成的实际场景。
ui_devex.summary_en: Llama.cpp is an open-source C/C++ implementation that enables efficient large language model inference on consumer hardware, solving the challenge of running sophisticated AI without expensive cloud infrastructure. It achieves remarkable performance through GGML's quantization techniques and optimized CPU computation, demonstrating how careful memory management can make billion-parameter models accessible. Developers can integrate it into desktop applications, build local AI assistants, or experiment with custom model deployments using its straightforward C/C++ API for real-time text generation tasks.

ui_devex.name: whisper
ui_devex.summary: Whisper 是一个开源语音识别系统，能够高精度转录多种语言的音频，解决了不同口音和嘈杂环境下自动转录的可靠性难题。其核心技术在于通过弱监督方式在68万小时多语言网络数据上训练，无需针对特定领域微调即可实现强大泛化能力。你可以用 Python 直接转录播客、会议录音或视频内容，也可基于其架构开发实时字幕、医疗听写等专业应用，体验大规模弱监督学习在语音领域的实际效果。
ui_devex.summary_en: Whisper is an open-source speech recognition system that transcribes audio across multiple languages with remarkable accuracy, solving the challenge of reliable automated transcription for diverse accents and noisy recordings. Its key innovation lies in training on 680,000 hours of multilingual web data using weak supervision, enabling robust generalization without domain-specific fine-tuning. You can use it via Python to transcribe podcasts, meetings, or videos, or fine-tune it for specialized applications like medical dictation or real-time captioning.

data_tooling.name: TypeScript
data_tooling.summary: TypeScript 是 JavaScript 的超集，通过引入静态类型系统帮助开发者在编码阶段发现错误，提升代码质量和可维护性。其核心设计采用渐进式类型，允许在现有 JavaScript 项目中逐步添加类型约束，同时保持完全兼容。开发者可从为变量添加基础类型注解开始，逐步使用接口、泛型等高级特性，结合 IDE 的智能提示和重构工具，构建更可靠的前后端应用，特别适合大型项目协作和长期维护。
data_tooling.summary_en: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that adds static type checking to help developers catch errors early and write more maintainable code. Its key innovation is gradual typing, allowing developers to add types incrementally while maintaining full JavaScript compatibility. You can start by adding type annotations to existing JavaScript files, then leverage advanced features like interfaces and generics to build robust applications with better tooling support and autocompletion.

Developers can integrate it into applications needing structured reasoning, such as educational tools, data analysis pipelines, or automated troubleshooting systems, by leveraging its API or fine-tuning on domain-specific datasets.

edge_embedded.name: rustdesk
edge_embedded.summary: RustDesk 是一款开源远程桌面应用，专为自托管设计，解决了对商业远程控制工具依赖和数据隐私的担忧。它完全使用 Rust 语言构建，通过点对点直连技术实现设备间通信，避免了中心服务器中转，既降低了延迟又提升了安全性。你可以将其部署在自有服务器上实现完全数据自主，用于远程技术支持、跨平台文件访问或安全办公场景，体验高效且私密的远程连接方案。
edge_embedded.summary_en: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application that enables secure cross-platform device access, addressing the need for privacy-focused alternatives to commercial solutions like TeamViewer. Built entirely in Rust, it leverages peer-to-peer connections for direct device communication, ensuring low latency and enhanced security without relying on centralized servers. You can self-host it on your own infrastructure for complete data control, use it for remote IT support, or access work files from personal devices while maintaining privacy.

Security teams can use it to discover new testing methodologies, while developers can study these resources to understand attack vectors and build more secure applications from the start.

edge_embedded.name: tauri
edge_embedded.summary: Tauri 是一款开源框架，用于构建轻量级桌面与移动应用。它支持开发者使用 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 编写前端界面，同时以 Rust 处理后端逻辑，兼顾性能与安全。其技术核心是直接调用系统原生 Webview，而非嵌入完整浏览器引擎，从而显著减小应用体积、缩短启动时间并提升效率。该框架支持跨平台部署，可通过 Rust 绑定访问系统 API，适用于低资源工具、跨平台软件及混合开发场景，助力 Web 开发者便捷开发原生应用。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Tauri is a framework for building lightweight desktop and mobile applications using web technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the frontend, while leveraging Rust for the backend to ensure high performance and security. Its core innovation lies in using the system's native webview instead of bundling a full browser, resulting in significantly smaller app sizes and faster startup times compared to similar tools. Developers can create cross-platform apps with minimal resource footprint, integrate with system APIs through Rust, and deploy the same codebase across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms for efficient prototyping or production apps.

edge_embedded.summary: TypeScript 是 JavaScript 的超集，通过引入静态类型系统帮助开发者在编码阶段发现错误，提升代码质量和可维护性。其核心设计采用渐进式类型，允许在现有 JavaScript 项目中逐步添加类型约束，同时保持完全兼容。开发者可从为变量添加基础类型注解开始，逐步使用接口、泛型等高级特性，结合 IDE 的智能提示和重构工具，构建更可靠的前后端应用，特别适合大型项目协作和长期维护。
edge_embedded.summary_en: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that adds static type checking to help developers catch errors early and write more maintainable code. Its key innovation is gradual typing, allowing developers to add types incrementally while maintaining full JavaScript compatibility. You can start by adding type annotations to existing JavaScript files, then leverage advanced features like interfaces and generics to build robust applications with better tooling support and autocompletion.

edge_embedded.name: nodebestpractices
edge_embedded.summary: NodeBestPractices 是一个全面的 Node.js 开发最佳实践集合，帮助开发者通过系统化的指导避免常见陷阱，构建更可靠、可维护的应用程序。它将实践分为项目结构、错误处理、测试等模块，每个建议都配有具体代码示例和原理说明，而非抽象理论。开发者可在代码审查时参考这些规范，将关键检查点集成到持续集成流程中，或逐步改造现有项目——比如从改进错误处理开始，再到优化性能和安全配置，实现渐进式的质量提升。
edge_embedded.summary_en: NodeBestPractices is a comprehensive collection of Node.js development guidelines that helps developers build more reliable and maintainable applications by addressing common pitfalls and architectural challenges. edge_embedded.name: Web-Dev-For-Beginners
edge_embedded.summary: Web-Dev-For-Beginners 是一个专为编程新手设计的 24 课结构化课程，通过将复杂的网页开发知识分解为 12 周的学习计划，解决了初学者面对众多技术选项时的困惑。课程采用纯 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 进行教学，避免框架依赖，让学习者先掌握核心原理再接触高级工具。你可以按周完成实际网页项目，根据个人进度调整学习节奏，或将其作为编程工作坊和教学机构的完整教材，快速建立扎实的前端开发基础。

You can follow the 12-week schedule to build real websites, adapt lessons for self-paced learning, or use it as teaching material for coding workshops and classroom instruction.

edge_embedded.name: vue-element-admin
edge_embedded.summary: Vue Element Admin 是一个基于 Vue.js 和 Element UI 构建的完整后台管理系统模板，解决了企业级管理界面快速开发的难题。它通过预置用户管理、数据可视化、权限控制等常用模块，并支持国际化，让开发者能直接复用成熟的界面模式。技术亮点包括动态路由配置、角色权限管理和响应式布局设计，展示了如何优雅处理复杂的前端状态和交互逻辑。你可以将其作为项目起点，根据业务需求定制组件，或学习其模块化架构来优化自己的管理后台开发流程。

Its technical strength lies in providing pre-built components for common admin tasks like user management, data visualization, and permission control with internationalization support. Developers can use it as a starter template, customize the layout and components for their specific needs, or study its implementation of complex UI patterns like dynamic routing and role-based access control.

agents_workflows.name: deno
agents_workflows.summary: Deno 是一个现代化的 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 运行时，它通过默认安全的设计解决了 Node.js 的权限管理问题，要求显式授权才能访问文件、网络等系统资源。其内置 TypeScript 编译器和标准库免除了复杂的构建配置，同时基于 Rust 的实现保证了高性能执行。开发者可以直接用它构建安全的服务器应用、脚本工具或 API 服务，通过实践其权限沙箱机制来学习如何设计更可靠的系统架构。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Deno is a secure JavaScript/TypeScript runtime that addresses Node.js security gaps by enforcing explicit permissions for file, network, and environment access. Its built-in TypeScript compiler and standard library eliminate dependency management overhead while maintaining performance through Rust implementation. Developers can immediately build server-side applications, scripts, or tools using Deno's zero-config approach, experimenting with its permission system to create safer web services and automation workflows.

agents_workflows.summary: Puppeteer 是一个 Node.js 库，提供高级 API 来编程控制 Chrome 或 Firefox 浏览器，解决了测试和网页抓取中浏览器自动化的需求。其核心技术是通过 DevTools 协议与浏览器直接通信，实现对页面、网络请求和用户交互的精确控制，无需人工干预。开发者可用它自动化表单提交、生成页面截图、测试 Web 应用或抓取动态内容，只需用 JavaScript 编写浏览器操作脚本即可快速上手实验。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Puppeteer is a Node.js library that provides a high-level API to control Chrome or Firefox browsers programmatically, solving the need for reliable browser automation in testing and web scraping. Its key innovation is using the DevTools Protocol to communicate directly with browsers, enabling precise control over pages, network requests, and user interactions without manual intervention. Developers can use it to automate form submissions, generate screenshots, test web applications, or scrape dynamic content by scripting browser actions in JavaScript.

deployment_serving.name: deno
deployment_serving.summary: Deno 是一个现代化的 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 运行时，它通过默认安全的设计解决了 Node.js 的权限管理问题，要求显式授权才能访问文件、网络等系统资源。其内置 TypeScript 编译器和标准库免除了复杂的构建配置，同时基于 Rust 的实现保证了高性能执行。开发者可以直接用它构建安全的服务器应用、脚本工具或 API 服务，通过实践其权限沙箱机制来学习如何设计更可靠的系统架构。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Deno is a secure JavaScript/TypeScript runtime that addresses Node.js security gaps by enforcing explicit permissions for file, network, and environment access. Its built-in TypeScript compiler and standard library eliminate dependency management overhead while maintaining performance through Rust implementation. Developers can immediately build server-side applications, scripts, or tools using Deno's zero-config approach, experimenting with its permission system to create safer web services and automation workflows.

deployment_serving.name: rustdesk
deployment_serving.summary: RustDesk 是一款开源远程桌面应用，专为自托管设计，解决了对商业远程控制工具依赖和数据隐私的担忧。它完全使用 Rust 语言构建，通过点对点直连技术实现设备间通信，避免了中心服务器中转，既降低了延迟又提升了安全性。你可以将其部署在自有服务器上实现完全数据自主，用于远程技术支持、跨平台文件访问或安全办公场景，体验高效且私密的远程连接方案。
deployment_serving.summary_en: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application that enables secure cross-platform device access, addressing the need for privacy-focused alternatives to commercial solutions like TeamViewer. Built entirely in Rust, it leverages peer-to-peer connections for direct device communication, ensuring low latency and enhanced security without relying on centralized servers. You can self-host it on your own infrastructure for complete data control, use it for remote IT support, or access work files from personal devices while maintaining privacy.

Developers can integrate it via Hugging Face for text generation, code assistance, or research experiments, making it ideal for building intelligent applications that require sophisticated language understanding without enterprise-scale infrastructure.

deployment_serving.name: frp
deployment_serving.summary: FRP 是一个快速反向代理工具，专门解决本地服务器在 NAT 或防火墙后难以被公网访问的常见问题，让开发者能够轻松将本地服务暴露到互联网。它通过客户端和服务端组件建立安全隧道，高效地转发外部请求到内部服务，并智能处理网络地址转换等复杂场景。使用 FRP 只需简单配置即可搭建代理通道，非常适合测试 Web 应用、分享开发原型、或为演示协作创建临时公网端点，是开发调试和临时部署的实用选择。
deployment_serving.summary_en: FRP is a fast reverse proxy that solves the common challenge of exposing local servers behind NATs or firewalls to the internet, enabling developers to share web services or APIs from their local machines. deployment_serving.name: tauri
deployment_serving.summary: Tauri 是一款开源框架，用于构建轻量级桌面与移动应用。它支持开发者使用 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 编写前端界面，同时以 Rust 处理后端逻辑，兼顾性能与安全。其技术核心是直接调用系统原生 Webview，而非嵌入完整浏览器引擎，从而显著减小应用体积、缩短启动时间并提升效率。该框架支持跨平台部署，可通过 Rust 绑定访问系统 API，适用于低资源工具、跨平台软件及混合开发场景，助力 Web 开发者便捷开发原生应用。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Tauri is a framework for building lightweight desktop and mobile applications using web technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the frontend, while leveraging Rust for the backend to ensure high performance and security. Its core innovation lies in using the system's native webview instead of bundling a full browser, resulting in significantly smaller app sizes and faster startup times compared to similar tools. Developers can create cross-platform apps with minimal resource footprint, integrate with system APIs through Rust, and deploy the same codebase across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms for efficient prototyping or production apps.

deployment_serving.name: v2rayN
deployment_serving.summary: v2rayN 是一款跨平台图形化代理客户端，核心解决网络访问限制与隐私保护问题，通过集成 Xray、sing-box 等内核支持 V2Ray、Trojan 等多种协议。其设计亮点在于将复杂的代理配置抽象为直观操作界面，让用户无需深入协议细节即可灵活组合路由规则。实际应用中，你可快速部署于 Windows、Linux 或 macOS 系统，用于突破地域内容封锁、加密敏感数据传输，或为特定应用设置独立代理通道——无论是开发跨境服务测试，还是构建个人隐私网络，都能直接上手实践。
deployment_serving.summary_en: v2rayN is a versatile GUI client that enables secure internet access by routing traffic through multiple proxy protocols, addressing censorship and privacy concerns. It uniquely integrates Xray, sing-box, and other cores into a unified interface, simplifying complex proxy configurations for everyday users. You can deploy it on Windows, Linux, or macOS to bypass geo-restrictions, encrypt connections, or build custom routing rules for specific applications—ideal for developers testing region-locked services or privacy-conscious users seeking reliable anonymity tools.

deployment_serving.name: llama.cpp
deployment_serving.summary: Llama.cpp 是一个用 C/C++ 实现的开源项目，专门解决在普通硬件上高效运行大语言模型的难题，让用户无需依赖昂贵的云端计算资源。它通过 GGML 量化技术和优化的 CPU 计算实现高性能推理，展示了如何通过精细的内存管理让数十亿参数模型在本地设备上流畅运行。开发者可以将其集成到桌面应用中，构建本地 AI 助手，或利用其简洁的 C/C++ API 进行自定义模型部署实验，非常适合需要实时文本生成的实际场景。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Llama.cpp is an open-source C/C++ implementation that enables efficient large language model inference on consumer hardware, solving the challenge of running sophisticated AI without expensive cloud infrastructure. It achieves remarkable performance through GGML's quantization techniques and optimized CPU computation, demonstrating how careful memory management can make billion-parameter models accessible. Developers can integrate it into desktop applications, build local AI assistants, or experiment with custom model deployments using its straightforward C/C++ API for real-time text generation tasks.

framework_core.name: deno
framework_core.summary: Deno 是一个现代化的 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 运行时，它通过默认安全的设计解决了 Node.js 的权限管理问题，要求显式授权才能访问文件、网络等系统资源。其内置 TypeScript 编译器和标准库免除了复杂的构建配置，同时基于 Rust 的实现保证了高性能执行。开发者可以直接用它构建安全的服务器应用、脚本工具或 API 服务，通过实践其权限沙箱机制来学习如何设计更可靠的系统架构。
framework_core.summary_en: Deno is a secure JavaScript/TypeScript runtime that addresses Node.js security gaps by enforcing explicit permissions for file, network, and environment access. Its built-in TypeScript compiler and standard library eliminate dependency management overhead while maintaining performance through Rust implementation. Developers can immediately build server-side applications, scripts, or tools using Deno's zero-config approach, experimenting with its permission system to create safer web services and automation workflows.

framework_core.summary: Angular 是一个基于 TypeScript 的完整 Web 框架，专门解决构建大规模、可维护 Web 应用的复杂性。它通过依赖注入和双向数据绑定提供结构化架构，其组件化设计配合声明式模板让开发者能够创建可复用的 UI 元素，同时借助 TypeScript 集成确保类型安全和更好的工具支持。你可以使用 Angular CLI 快速开发渐进式 Web 应用、企业级应用或单页面应用，这套框架特别适合需要可扩展前端解决方案的开发团队进行高效协作和长期维护。

framework_core.summary: Awesome-Hacking是一个系统化的网络安全资源集合，专为渗透测试与安全研究设计。它分类整合了逆向工程、模糊测试、漏洞挖掘等领域的工具与学习资料，帮助从业者快速获取所需资源。该项目将分散的安全知识体系化，使研究人员能专注于技术实践。安全团队可将其作为测试参考，开发者也能通过学习攻击技术来构建更健壮的防御体系。
framework_core.summary_en: Awesome-Hacking is a curated collection of security resources that helps cybersecurity professionals quickly access high-quality tools and knowledge for penetration testing and vulnerability research. It organizes specialized lists covering areas like reverse engineering, fuzzing, and bug bounty hunting, saving researchers from scattered searches. Security teams can use it to discover new testing methodologies, while developers can study these resources to understand attack vectors and build more secure applications from the start.

framework_core.summary_en: Shadcn/ui is a collection of beautifully-designed, accessible React components that solve the challenge of building consistent, production-ready user interfaces without vendor lock-in. It works by providing copy-paste components built with Radix UI and Tailwind CSS, giving developers full control over the code rather than installing dependencies. You can use these components directly in Next.js, React, or other frameworks to quickly prototype or build polished applications while maintaining complete customization freedom.

framework_core.name: tauri
framework_core.summary: Tauri 是一款开源框架，用于构建轻量级桌面与移动应用。它支持开发者使用 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 编写前端界面，同时以 Rust 处理后端逻辑，兼顾性能与安全。其技术核心是直接调用系统原生 Webview，而非嵌入完整浏览器引擎，从而显著减小应用体积、缩短启动时间并提升效率。该框架支持跨平台部署，可通过 Rust 绑定访问系统 API，适用于低资源工具、跨平台软件及混合开发场景，助力 Web 开发者便捷开发原生应用。
framework_core.summary_en: Tauri is a framework for building lightweight desktop and mobile applications using web technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the frontend, while leveraging Rust for the backend to ensure high performance and security. Its core innovation lies in using the system's native webview instead of bundling a full browser, resulting in significantly smaller app sizes and faster startup times compared to similar tools. Developers can create cross-platform apps with minimal resource footprint, integrate with system APIs through Rust, and deploy the same codebase across Windows, macOS, Linux, and mobile platforms for efficient prototyping or production apps.

framework_core.name: puppeteer
framework_core.summary: Puppeteer 是一个 Node.js 库，提供高级 API 来编程控制 Chrome 或 Firefox 浏览器，解决了测试和网页抓取中浏览器自动化的需求。其核心技术是通过 DevTools 协议与浏览器直接通信，实现对页面、网络请求和用户交互的精确控制，无需人工干预。开发者可用它自动化表单提交、生成页面截图、测试 Web 应用或抓取动态内容，只需用 JavaScript 编写浏览器操作脚本即可快速上手实验。
framework_core.summary_en: Puppeteer is a Node.js library that provides a high-level API to control Chrome or Firefox browsers programmatically, solving the need for reliable browser automation in testing and web scraping. Its key innovation is using the DevTools Protocol to communicate directly with browsers, enabling precise control over pages, network requests, and user interactions without manual intervention. Developers can use it to automate form submissions, generate screenshots, test web applications, or scrape dynamic content by scripting browser actions in JavaScript.

framework_core.name: ComfyUI
framework_core.summary: ComfyUI 是一款基于节点界面的扩散模型工具，通过可视化编程让复杂AI图像生成流程变得直观可控。其模块化设计将高级AI管线拆解为可组合的组件，揭示了如何通过节点连接实现灵活的工作流编排。用户可通过拖拽节点构建自定义生成流程，修改现有图像处理管线，或基于其后端API开发全新的视觉AI应用，非常适合想要深入理解扩散模型工作原理并创建个性化图像生成方案的研究者和开发者。
framework_core.summary_en: ComfyUI is a powerful node-based interface that makes complex AI image generation workflows accessible through visual programming. Its modular architecture allows users to chain together diffusion model components like building blocks, revealing how advanced AI pipelines can be decomposed into reusable elements. You can experiment by dragging nodes to create custom generation workflows, modify existing pipelines, or build entirely new visual AI applications using its API backend.

framework_core.name: fastapi
framework_core.summary: FastAPI 是一个现代化的 Python Web 框架，专为快速构建高性能 API 而设计。它通过 Python 类型提示自动生成 OpenAPI 文档，核心创新在于结合 Pydantic 实现自动数据验证、序列化和交互式 API 文档生成。开发者只需定义类型注解即可获得完整的输入输出验证，内置异步支持确保高并发性能。典型应用包括微服务架构、数据科学 API 接口和实时应用开发，特别适合需要强类型保障和快速迭代的项目，你可以用它快速搭建生产级 API 服务并享受自动文档带来的开发便利。
framework_core.summary_en: FastAPI is a modern Python web framework that simplifies building high-performance APIs by automatically generating OpenAPI documentation from type hints. Its key innovation leverages Python type annotations with Pydantic for automatic data validation, serialization, and interactive API docs. Developers can quickly create production-ready REST APIs with built-in support for async operations, making it ideal for microservices, data science APIs, and real-time applications where type safety and developer experience matter most.

framework_core.name: tailwindcss
framework_core.summary: Tailwind CSS 是一个实用优先的 CSS 框架，通过提供原子化的 CSS 类来解决传统 CSS 文件臃肿和命名复杂的问题。其技术核心在于直接在 HTML 中使用预设的实用类组合构建界面，无需编写自定义 CSS，从而实现快速响应式开发和一致的设计系统。开发者可通过 PostCSS 集成到任何项目中，通过配置文件定制设计规范，并完全使用实用类构建完整界面，无需编写传统 CSS 文件即可实现现代化网页设计。
framework_core.summary_en: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework that solves the problem of bloated CSS files and complex naming conventions by providing low-level utility classes for rapid UI development. Its technical innovation lies in composing designs directly in HTML using predefined classes instead of writing custom CSS, enabling consistent design systems and responsive layouts. Developers can integrate it into any project via PostCSS, customize the design system through configuration files, and build complete interfaces without writing traditional CSS files.

framework_core.name: storybook
framework_core.summary: Storybook 是一个开源工具，专门解决在独立环境中开发 UI 组件的难题，让开发者无需依赖完整应用即可构建和测试组件。它通过创建“故事”来展示组件在不同属性和状态下的表现，支持实时编辑和交互测试，便于团队协作和视觉验证。你可以用它搭建组件库、编写设计系统文档，或集成自动化测试工具进行视觉回归测试，提升前端开发效率和质量。
framework_core.summary_en: Storybook is an open-source tool that solves the challenge of developing UI components in isolation from the main application, preventing context-switching and enabling focused testing. It works by creating 'stories'—reusable test cases that render components with specific props and states, allowing developers to visually verify behavior across different scenarios. You can use it to build component libraries, document design systems, or automate visual regression testing by integrating with testing frameworks like Chromatic or Percy.

framework_core.name: system-prompts-and-models-of-ai-tools
framework_core.summary: 该项目系统整理了多种AI编程工具的系统提示词与模型配置，帮助开发者深入理解不同AI助手处理编程任务的内在逻辑。通过分析Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Devin AI等工具的实际工作指令，你可以学习到如何设计有效的AI交互模式。这些资源展示了不同工具如何构建代码补全、错误修复和项目开发的智能辅助流程。你可以直接借鉴这些提示词模板，根据特定编程语言或开发场景进行定制化调整，或者通过对比研究来优化自己的AI工具使用策略，提升开发效率。
framework_core.summary_en: This repository collects system prompts and models from various AI coding tools, helping developers understand how different AI assistants approach programming tasks. It reveals the underlying instructions that shape AI behavior across platforms like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Devin AI. You can study these prompts to learn effective AI communication patterns, adapt them for your own projects, or compare how different tools structure their coding assistance. Try modifying these system prompts to customize AI behavior for specific programming languages or development workflows.

security_safety.summary: Angular 是一个基于 TypeScript 的完整 Web 框架，专门解决构建大规模、可维护 Web 应用的复杂性。它通过依赖注入和双向数据绑定提供结构化架构，其组件化设计配合声明式模板让开发者能够创建可复用的 UI 元素，同时借助 TypeScript 集成确保类型安全和更好的工具支持。你可以使用 Angular CLI 快速开发渐进式 Web 应用、企业级应用或单页面应用，这套框架特别适合需要可扩展前端解决方案的开发团队进行高效协作和长期维护。
security_safety.summary_en: Angular is a comprehensive TypeScript-based web framework that solves the complexity of building large-scale, maintainable web applications by providing a structured architecture with dependency injection and two-way data binding. Its component-based design with declarative templates enables developers to create reusable UI elements while ensuring type safety and better tooling support through TypeScript integration. You can start building progressive web apps, enterprise applications, or single-page applications using Angular CLI for rapid development and testing, making it ideal for teams needing scalable frontend solutions.

security_safety.summary_en: Awesome-Hacking is a curated collection of security resources that helps cybersecurity professionals quickly access high-quality tools and knowledge for penetration testing and vulnerability research. It organizes specialized lists covering areas like reverse engineering, fuzzing, and bug bounty hunting, saving researchers from scattered searches. Security teams can use it to discover new testing methodologies, while developers can study these resources to understand attack vectors and build more secure applications from the start.

security_safety.name: fastapi
security_safety.summary: FastAPI 是一个现代化的 Python Web 框架，专为快速构建高性能 API 而设计。它通过 Python 类型提示自动生成 OpenAPI 文档，核心创新在于结合 Pydantic 实现自动数据验证、序列化和交互式 API 文档生成。开发者只需定义类型注解即可获得完整的输入输出验证，内置异步支持确保高并发性能。典型应用包括微服务架构、数据科学 API 接口和实时应用开发，特别适合需要强类型保障和快速迭代的项目，你可以用它快速搭建生产级 API 服务并享受自动文档带来的开发便利。
security_safety.summary_en: FastAPI is a modern Python web framework that simplifies building high-performance APIs by automatically generating OpenAPI documentation from type hints. Its key innovation leverages Python type annotations with Pydantic for automatic data validation, serialization, and interactive API docs. Developers can quickly create production-ready REST APIs with built-in support for async operations, making it ideal for microservices, data science APIs, and real-time applications where type safety and developer experience matter most.

security_safety.name: supabase
security_safety.summary: Supabase 是一个开源的 Firebase 替代方案，为开发者提供基于 PostgreSQL 的完整后端解决方案，无需分别管理数据库、身份验证和 API 服务。其核心设计巧妙利用 PostgreSQL 原生功能，通过内置扩展实现行级安全策略和实时数据订阅，同时根据数据库模式自动生成类型安全的 API 接口。开发者可直接连接 Supabase 项目快速构建全栈应用，立即专注于前端开发而无需担心后端基础设施，特别适合需要实时功能、严格数据权限控制的 Web 和移动应用场景，让团队以最小配置获得生产就绪的后端服务。
security_safety.summary_en: Supabase is an open-source Firebase alternative that provides developers with a complete backend solution using PostgreSQL, eliminating the need to manage separate services for databases, authentication, and APIs. Its key innovation lies in leveraging PostgreSQL's native capabilities like row-level security and real-time subscriptions through built-in extensions, while automatically generating type-safe APIs from your database schema. Developers can quickly prototype full-stack applications by connecting directly to their Supabase project, enabling immediate focus on frontend development with secure, scalable backend infrastructure ready out-of-the-box.

security_safety.name: v2rayN
security_safety.summary: v2rayN 是一款跨平台图形化代理客户端，核心解决网络访问限制与隐私保护问题，通过集成 Xray、sing-box 等内核支持 V2Ray、Trojan 等多种协议。其设计亮点在于将复杂的代理配置抽象为直观操作界面，让用户无需深入协议细节即可灵活组合路由规则。实际应用中，你可快速部署于 Windows、Linux 或 macOS 系统，用于突破地域内容封锁、加密敏感数据传输，或为特定应用设置独立代理通道——无论是开发跨境服务测试，还是构建个人隐私网络，都能直接上手实践。
security_safety.summary_en: v2rayN is a versatile GUI client that enables secure internet access by routing traffic through multiple proxy protocols, addressing censorship and privacy concerns. It uniquely integrates Xray, sing-box, and other cores into a unified interface, simplifying complex proxy configurations for everyday users. You can deploy it on Windows, Linux, or macOS to bypass geo-restrictions, encrypt connections, or build custom routing rules for specific applications—ideal for developers testing region-locked services or privacy-conscious users seeking reliable anonymity tools.

optimization_compilers.name: llama.cpp
optimization_compilers.summary: Llama.cpp 是一个用 C/C++ 实现的开源项目，专门解决在普通硬件上高效运行大语言模型的难题，让用户无需依赖昂贵的云端计算资源。它通过 GGML 量化技术和优化的 CPU 计算实现高性能推理，展示了如何通过精细的内存管理让数十亿参数模型在本地设备上流畅运行。开发者可以将其集成到桌面应用中，构建本地 AI 助手，或利用其简洁的 C/C++ API 进行自定义模型部署实验，非常适合需要实时文本生成的实际场景。
optimization_compilers.summary_en: Llama.cpp is an open-source C/C++ implementation that enables efficient large language model inference on consumer hardware, solving the challenge of running sophisticated AI without expensive cloud infrastructure. It achieves remarkable performance through GGML's quantization techniques and optimized CPU computation, demonstrating how careful memory management can make billion-parameter models accessible. Developers can integrate it into desktop applications, build local AI assistants, or experiment with custom model deployments using its straightforward C/C++ API for real-time text generation tasks.
